name: Quaternium-22
description: Quaternium-22 (CAS 51812-80-7 ), also sold under the trade name Ceraphyl 60, is a mild quaternary ammonium surfactant derived from gluconamide chemistry. It functions as a conditioning agent, emulsifier, and humectant in rinse-off and leave-on formulations. In hair care, it deposits on the hair surface to reduce static, improve combability, and deliver a soft feel in conditioners, detangling sprays, and shampoo formulations. Skin care formulators use it in lotions and creams where it supports emulsion stability. The ingredient provides substantive moisturization across various cosmetic platforms. Its mildness profile makes it suitable for baby care and sensitive-skin product lines where conventional quats would be too harsh for the end user. In industrial and institutional cleaning formulations, it contributes wetting and surface-active performance. It maintains compatibility with other surfactant systems, ensuring stability in complex chemical mixtures and diverse cleaning applications. Quaternium-22 is typically supplied as a liquid solution, with concentration varying by manufacturer. It is available in cosmetic-grade quality suitable for personal care applications, and technical-grade variants serve industrial cleaning end uses. Buyers should confirm active content and pH specifications when evaluating lots for formulation compatibility.
